verdict.rationale: Linear documents an official MCP server at linear.app/docs/mcp. Its integrations directory lists first-party connections for Cursor and Claude to "the Linear MCP server," and the changelog notes that Linear's MCP supports Okta-managed employee access. That clearly delivers the ability to connect an agent through an official MCP server. Missing for 10: detail on the MCP tool surface and operations exposed, setup and authentication steps beyond the Okta note, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
